import numpy as np, wave, os
SR=44100
OUT='/workspace/src/samples'

C4=261.625565

    e=(1-np.exp(-t/max(a,1e-5)))*(0.82*np.exp(-t/d)+0.18*np.exp(-t/(d*3.2)))
    end=np.ones_like(t)
    if tail>0:
        dur=t[-1]+1/SR
        end=np.clip((dur-t)/tail,0,1)
    return e*end

def normwrite(name,x,peak=.88):
    x=np.nan_to_num(x)
    x=x-np.mean(x)
    m=np.max(np.abs(x))
    if m: x=x/m*peak
    y=np.int16(np.clip(x,-1,1)*32767)
    p=os.path.join(OUT,name+'.wav')
    with wave.open(p,'wb') as w:
        w.setnchannels(1); w.setsampwidth(2); w.setframerate(SR); w.writeframes(y.tobytes())
    print(name, len(y), 'samples', f'{len(y)/SR:.3f}s')

    amt=np.clip((t-delay)/.18,0,1)
    inst=f*(1+depth*amt*np.sin(2*np.pi*rate*t))
    return 2*np.pi*np.cumsum(inst)/SR

dur=1.30; t=np.arange(int(SR*dur))/SR; ph=phase_vibrato(t)
x=np.zeros_like(t)
duty=.27

    # pulse Fourier coefficients; roll off top harmonics for a polished chip timbre
    coef=2*np.sin(np.pi*n*duty)/(np.pi*n)*np.exp(-n/18)
    x += coef*np.cos(n*ph-np.pi*n*duty)

x *= env_ar(t,.0025,.44,.10)
normwrite('01_neon_pulse',x)

dur=1.10; t=np.arange(int(SR*dur))/SR; ph=phase_vibrato(t,C4,4.8,.0016,.14)
x=np.zeros_like(t)
for k,n in enumerate(range(1,14,2)):
    x += ((-1)**k)/(n*n)*np.sin(n*ph)
x += .08*np.sin(2*ph+.6)+.025*np.sin(5*ph)
x*=env_ar(t,.004,.36,.11)
normwrite('02_silver_echo',x)

# 3/4 - complementary stereo chip plucks
for idx,(name,duty,bright) in enumerate([('03_arp_left',.50,1.0),('04_arp_right',.375,.86)]):
    dur=.34; t=np.arange(int(SR*dur))/SR; ph=2*np.pi*C4*t
    x=np.zeros_like(t)
    for n in range(1,12):
        coef=2*np.sin(np.pi*n*duty)/(np.pi*n)*np.exp(-n/(9*bright))
        x += coef*np.cos(n*ph-np.pi*n*duty)
    # two-stage percussive envelope gives a crisp but not clicky attack
    e=(1-np.exp(-t/.0015))*(.78*np.exp(-t/.055)+.22*np.exp(-t/.18))*np.clip((dur-t)/.035,0,1)
    x*=e
    normwrite(name,x,.82)

    x += .13*np.sin(2*np.pi*C4*.5*t)

    x*=e
    normwrite(name,x,.76)

dur=.82; t=np.arange(int(SR*dur))/SR; ph=2*np.pi*C4*t
x=.86*np.sin(ph)+.30*np.sin(2*ph+.1)+.18*np.sin(3*ph)+.09*np.sin(4*ph)
# short downward attack chirp adds tracker-bass definition
x += .12*np.sin(2*np.pi*(C4*1.8*t - C4*.9*t*t/max(dur,.01)))*np.exp(-t/.06)
e=(1-np.exp(-t/.0018))*(.78*np.exp(-t/.19)+.22*np.exp(-t/.62))*np.clip((dur-t)/.055,0,1)
x*=e
normwrite('07_rubber_bass',x,.90)

x += .045*click*np.exp(-t/.008)
normwrite('08_pixel_kick',x,.94)

def highpass(noise, smooth=18):
    ker=np.ones(smooth)/smooth
    low=np.convolve(noise,ker,'same')
    return noise-low

dur=.38; t=np.arange(int(SR*dur))/SR
n=rng.normal(size=len(t)); hp=highpass(n,25)

body=np.sin(2*np.pi*(185*t-55*t*t))*np.exp(-t/.11)

x*= (1-np.exp(-t/.0008))*np.clip((dur-t)/.04,0,1)
normwrite('09_bit_snare',x,.88)

n=highpass(rng.normal(size=len(t)),34)
metal=sum(np.sin(2*np.pi*f*t+p) for f,p in [(6413,.2),(8241,1.7),(10531,2.1)])
x=(.82*n+.18*metal)*np.exp(-t/.028)*(1-np.exp(-t/.00035))*np.clip((dur-t)/.018,0,1)
normwrite('10_hat_closed',x,.73)

# 11 - open hat
dur=.56; t=np.arange(int(SR*dur))/SR
n=highpass(rng.normal(size=len(t)),42)
metal=sum(np.sin(2*np.pi*f*t+p) for f,p in [(5279,.4),(7103,1.4),(9341,2.6),(11969,.8)])
x=(.78*n+.22*metal)*(.67*np.exp(-t/.13)+.33*np.exp(-t/.31))*(1-np.exp(-t/.0005))*np.clip((dur-t)/.06,0,1)
normwrite('11_hat_open',x,.72)

dur=1.55; t=np.arange(int(SR*dur))/SR
n=highpass(rng.normal(size=len(t)),70)
e=np.clip(t/dur,0,1)**1.7*np.clip((dur-t)/.025,0,1)
chirp=np.sin(2*np.pi*(340*t+1700*t*t/dur))
x=(.62*n+.38*chirp)*e
normwrite('12_data_rise',x,.68)

# 13 - short organ/chord stab
dur=.72; t=np.arange(int(SR*dur))/SR; ph=2*np.pi*C4*t
x=.72*np.sin(ph)+.36*np.sin(2*ph)+.19*np.sin(3*ph)+.12*np.sin(4*ph)+.08*np.sin(6*ph)
e=(1-np.exp(-t/.002))*(.72*np.exp(-t/.16)+.28*np.exp(-t/.48))*np.clip((dur-t)/.055,0,1)
x*=e
normwrite('13_code_stab',x,.84)

dur=1.15; t=np.arange(int(SR*dur))/SR; ph=phase_vibrato(t,C4,6.1,.0019,.08)
x=np.zeros_like(t)
for n in range(1,13):
    x += ((1/n) if n%2 else (.25/n))*np.sin(n*ph)*np.exp(-n/15)
x*=env_ar(t,.003,.39,.10)
normwrite('14_cyan_lead',x,.84)

# 15 - electronic tom / fill
dur=.52; t=np.arange(int(SR*dur))/SR
f=78+190*np.exp(-t/.10); ph=2*np.pi*np.cumsum(f)/SR
x=(np.sin(ph)+.20*np.sin(2*ph))*np.exp(-t/.19)*(1-np.exp(-t/.001))*np.clip((dur-t)/.04,0,1)
normwrite('15_vector_tom',x,.88)

# 16 - bell sparkle with inharmonic partials
dur=1.42; t=np.arange(int(SR*dur))/SR
x=np.zeros_like(t)
for mult,a,p,dec in [(1,1,0,1.1),(2.01,.43,.2,.75),(3.98,.20,1.3,.48),(6.37,.13,.8,.32),(9.1,.07,2.0,.22)]:

x*=(1-np.exp(-t/.0015))*np.clip((dur-t)/.12,0,1)
normwrite('16_hex_bell',x,.82)

def put(p,r,ch,note=None,ins=None,vol=None,fx=None,fp=None,replace=True):
    if not (0<=r<64): return
    key=(r,ch)
    d={} if (replace or key not in patterns[p]) else dict(patterns[p][key])
    if note is not None: d['note']=nn(note) if isinstance(note,int) else note
    if ins is not None: d['instrument']=ins
    if vol is not None: d['volume']=vol
    if fx is not None: d['effect']=fx
    if fp is not None: d['effect_param']=fp
    patterns[p][key]=d

def add_pads(p, density='bar'):

def add_arps(p, modes):
    if isinstance(modes,str): modes=[modes]*4
    seq=[0,2,1,2,3,2,1,2, 0,2,1,2,3,2,1,2]
    seq_alt=[0,1,2,1,3,1,2,1, 0,1,2,1,3,2,1,2]
    for b,(chname,mode) in enumerate(zip(HARMONY[p],modes)):
        notes=CHORDS[chname][2]; base=b*16
        if mode=='off': continue
        if mode=='half':
            for j,r in enumerate(range(0,16,2)):
                ch=ARPL if j%2==0 else ARPR; ins=I_ARPL if ch==ARPL else I_ARPR
                put(p,base+r,ch,notes[seq_alt[j*2]],ins)
        elif mode=='sparse':
            for j,r in enumerate([0,4,8,12]):
                ch=ARPL if j%2==0 else ARPR; ins=I_ARPL if ch==ARPL else I_ARPR
                put(p,base+r,ch,notes[[0,2,1,3][j]],ins)
        elif mode in ('full','high','roll'):
            sq=seq_alt if mode=='roll' else seq
            for r in range(16):
                # zig-zag the stereo starting side from bar to bar
                ch=ARPL if (r+b)%2==0 else ARPR; ins=I_ARPL if ch==ARPL else I_ARPR
                n=notes[sq[r]] + (12 if mode=='high' and r in (4,12) else 0)
                put(p,base+r,ch,n,ins)

    for b,chname in enumerate(HARMONY[p]):
        base=b*16; bass,pads,arp,color=CHORDS[chname]
        if style=='off': continue
        if style=='light': offs=[(2,color),(11,arp[0]+12)]
        elif style=='sync': offs=[(0,color),(6,arp[3]),(10,color),(14,arp[2])]
        elif style=='upbeat': offs=[(3,color),(7,arp[3]),(11,color),(15,arp[2])]
        else: offs=[]
        for r,n in offs: put(p,base+r,COUNTER,n,I_STAB)

def approach_note(cur,nextroot):
    # one-semitone approach chosen near the current bass octave
    target=nextroot
    while target<cur-5: target+=12
    while target>cur+7: target-=12
    return target-1 if target>=cur else target+1

def add_bass(p, styles):
    if isinstance(styles,str): styles=[styles]*4
    for b,(chname,style) in enumerate(zip(HARMONY[p],styles)):
        root=CHORDS[chname][0]; base=b*16
        nxt=CHORDS[HARMONY[p][b+1]][0] if b<3 else (CHORDS[HARMONY[p+1][0]][0] if p<19 else CHORDS[HARMONY[2][0]][0])
        if style=='off': continue
        if style=='sparse': ev=[(0,root),(8,root+12)]
        elif style=='basic': ev=[(0,root),(4,root+12),(7,root+7),(8,root),(12,root+7),(14,root+12)]
        elif style=='drive': ev=[(0,root),(3,root+12),(6,root+7),(8,root),(10,root+12),(12,root+7),(15,approach_note(root,nxt))]
        elif style=='four': ev=[(0,root),(2,root+12),(4,root+7),(6,root+12),(8,root),(10,root+12),(12,root+7),(14,root+12)]
        elif style=='rise': ev=[(0,root),(4,root+7),(8,root+12),(10,root+7),(12,root+12),(14,root+14),(15,approach_note(root,nxt))]
        else: ev=[]
        for r,n in ev: put(p,base+r,BASS,n,I_BASS)

def add_drums_bar(p,b,style,fill=False,suppress_perc=False):
    base=b*16
    if style=='off': return
    if style=='sparse':
        kicks=[0,8]; snares=[4,12]; hats=[2,6,10,14]
    elif style=='break':
        kicks=[0,3,8,10]; snares=[4,12]; hats=[1,3,5,7,9,11,13,15]
    elif style=='drive':
        kicks=[0,4,8,12]; snares=[4,12]; hats=[2,6,10,14]
    elif style=='busy':
        kicks=[0,4,7,8,10,12]; snares=[4,12,15]; hats=list(range(0,16,2))+[3,7,11,15]
    elif style=='build':
        kicks=[0,4,8,12]; snares=[4,12,14,15]; hats=list(range(0,16,2))
    else: return
    for r in kicks: put(p,base+r,KICK,60,I_KICK)
    for j,r in enumerate(snares):
        # last extra hit in busy patterns is a softer ghost
        if r==15 and style=='busy': put(p,base+r,SNARE,60,I_SNARE,fx=12,fp=24)
        else: put(p,base+r,SNARE,60,I_SNARE)
    for j,r in enumerate(hats):
        # Cxx makes alternating ticks breathe without relying on volume-column encoding
        vv=18 if (r%4) else 22
        put(p,base+r,HAT,60,I_HAT,fx=12,fp=vv)
    if not suppress_perc and style in ('drive','busy'):
        put(p,base+14,PERC,60,I_OPEN)
    if fill and not suppress_perc:
        # rising vector-tom fill, increasing pitch and density into the next section
        for rr,n in [(8,55),(11,57),(13,60),(14,62),(15,67)]:
            put(p,base+rr,PERC,n,I_TOM)

    for b,st in enumerate(styles):
